composition.serve_who: This sheet serves the vessel's primary bilge and fire fluid systems, detailing the main and auxiliary bilge pumping loops for clearing sumps across the vessel, as well as the electric and diesel seawater fire lines feeding the hydrants. This is evidenced by the title block 'BILGE & FIRE SYSTEM SCHEMATIC', the comprehensive layout of bilge sumps (Lazarette, Midship, Engine Room, Mast, Sail Locker), and the interconnected firelines.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The schematic depicts an emergency bilge suction pathway via the STBD Genset and exhaust water separator, aligning with established facts for the generator raw water pump.

functions.label: Emergency Bilge Suction
functions.what_it_does: Serves as an emergency, engine-driven, high-volume bilge pump by utilizing the generator's raw water cooling pump to draw directly from the Engine Room sump.

flow_scenarios.path: Engine Room Sump -> STBD Genset Raw Water Pump (Jabsco 43400) -> Overboard via Exhaust Water Separator

facts: The system utilizes a single, integrated main bilge manifold spanning the vessel, collecting from motorized strumbox pickups located in the Lazarette, Midship, Engine Room, Mast Area, ESS Enclosure, and Sail Locker sumps.
The Main Bilge Pump (Gianneschi ACB 431 B) draws from this manifold and discharges overboard via an anti-siphon loop.
The fire main is pressurized independently by an Electric Fire Pump (Gianneschi ACB 431 B) and a Diesel Fire Pump (Yanmar L48), both drawing from dedicated seawater pickups to supply hydrants.
Emergency engine-room flood suction is provided by the STBD generator's raw-water pump, which can draw directly from the engine room bilge and discharge overboard via the exhaust water separator.
Auxiliary bilge loops utilizing Whale Gulper 320 pumps provide localized clearance for the Engine Room and Mast Area sumps.

uncertainties: The exact state-alignment of the manual 3-way routing valves (e.g., 014-XX series) for directing flow to the portable oil storage tank vs overboard discharge lacks explicit operational threshold data.
